start.description: start: start date for the EvalMetrics call on the Sensor type

end.description: end: end date for the EvalMetrics call on the Sensor Type

interval.description: interval: interval or granularity for the EvalMetrics call on the Sensor type

windowPast.description: windowPast: how many datapoints you would want to look into the past from current timestamp

windowFuture.description: windowFuture: how many datapoints you would want to look into the future from current timestamp

windowSizeForPeakDetection.description: windowSizeForPeakDetection: how many datapoints you would want to consider for calculating the peaks

title:
Input spec to configure parameters of the regime shift calculations manually.
windowPast and windowFuture are associated with Wasserstein Distance
that calculates distance between two distributions.
windowSizeForPeakDetection is for computing peaks using scipy.signal package
on the distribution distance.
name: RegimeShiftSpec
